regimeSub: SPX +1.6% off lows as midterm volatility compresses; oil crashes to $94.62 erasing Iran war premium.
themes: Bullard Nov 4 calls for Dec hike per Kathleen Hays podcast; Musalem/Dallas Fed prior week aligned on 'soon' → 4% policy rate unchanged but Dec pricing firm with core PCE at 3.1%
10Y yield +4bp to 4.95% as election haven bid unwinds; 2s10s steepens to +34bp with 2Y at 4.61% → tech rotation into bonds reverses per Bloomberg AI selloff coverage
Lagarde ECB Feb 2027 exit confirmed per NYT/Guardian → EURUSD firms to 1.1265 as Le Pen risk priced; BOK Nov hike expectations per Reuters support KRW at 1342
Brent collapses 7.9% WoW to $94.62 as Iran war premium fully exits per Reuters July normalization → gold +3.1% to $4,073 on election hedging; VIX crushed to 16.61

headline: US midterms compress volatility as VIX plunges 20% to 16.61; oil collapses to $94 erasing Iran premium while Fed's Bullard/Musalem maintain Dec hike optionality with core PCE stuck at 3.1%.
